material_species_matrix.acceptance_basis: full finite-slab scoring, analytic mass/dose conversion, ledger closure, and <=2% Monte Carlo standard uncertainty. Absolute electromagnetic physics is accepted separately by the deterministic PSTAR/ASTAR tool; unrestricted stopping power is not treated as finite-slab absorbed energy because escaping delta electrons and nuclear interactions make those observables different.

convergence.transverse_size_rationale: changing slab area changes finite-slab mass and therefore Gy per one compact-plane primary by definition. Lateral escape convergence is tested on ionizing deposited energy; dose conversion is tested separately at every fixed geometry.
